description: HESTIA implements a behaviour digital twin for residential demand response. The research team publishes a Python repository and an archived version 0.1, with MIT rights confirmed by the GitHub licence metadata. The describing ORE article links theories of planned behaviour and self-determination to predictions of whether individuals will react to demand-response triggers. Coverage depends on the people and observations supplied to a run, not a fixed geographic dataset. The model can inform selection and timing of behavioural interventions in energy-control simulations. Its README is sparse, and this review did not establish a complete installation procedure or reproduce reported results. Predicted reactions remain uncertain and do not replace a physical building-energy model. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
